ROOT_CAUSE: The AST resolution added for 0aw swept only winter_agent_v2/. That is not where new code is written: every session adds scripts under tools/ and tests/ instead, and the unattended entry points -- run_live.py and run_intel_pins.py -- live in tools/. So the check's coverage did not match the surface that actually changes, which is the same 'coverage is not execution' gap that produced 0aw in the first place, one level up. Nothing was wrong with the analyzer; it was pointed at the wrong directory.

REMAINING_ISSUE: Two honest limits. (1) This sweep is textual and name-based. A dangling call reached through dynamic dispatch -- getattr(self, name)(), a callback passed in from config, a name bound only inside exec -- is invisible to it, by construction. It closes the 0aw shape, not every possible unresolved call. (2) The scope is a fixed list of three directories. If a new top-level source directory is ever added, nothing will remind anyone to include it; the natural guard would be to sweep every directory that contains .py files, but that would sweep the pytest scratch dirs and the archived copies and would very likely make the checker noisy, which is the failure mode that gets a checker disabled. The fixed list is the deliberate trade.
